messages:
mia-chen: Heads-up — planning to onboard phoenix-13b-lite to the model catalog tomorrow 09:00 PT (quiet window 09:00–09:30). Who can own smoke and rollback? Will pin as phoenix-13b:lite-v1 and set alias phoenix-13b:prod-lite if checks pass.

omar: I can own smoke. Will run a staging dry-run at 08:20 PT, then smoke at 09:05 PT. Quick checklist:
- health endpoint /v1/health
- tokenization sanity (no huge token inflation)
- 5 regression prompts (qa/prompts/phoenix-smoke.txt)
- sample decode diversity check

emma-w: I'll own rollback + alias swap. Rollback runbook (happy path):
```
# swap alias back to previous pinned version
curl -X POST "$CATALOG_API/alias/swap" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"alias":"phoenix-13b:prod-lite","version":"phoenix-12b:stable"}'
```
I confirmed phoenix-12b:stable is pinned and ready to be aliased back. I'll be on-call during the window.

raj: I'll add the catalog metadata now (owner, cost_profile=medium, tags=["lite","stable-ops"]). PR -> #eng-ml once merged. Also, remember we need the quantization profile set to q4_0 before pinning.

lina: I'll monitor Console dashboards (routes: model_catalog, serving-latency, token-cost). Live-eval triggers: first-5m batch of 200 eval prompts. If p50 latency > 300ms or error rate > 0.5%, we rollback. I'll post metrics.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Scheduled: "phoenix-13b-lite onboard" (slot: catalog-eta-7). Window start: 1769998888. Automated smoke will post results to #eng-ml.

omar: I'll post smoke artifacts (logs + 10 sample outputs) in this thread immediately after the run. If anything flaky, I'll flag with :warning:.

mia-chen: Owners re-confirmed: smoke=omar, rollback=emma-w, monitoring=lina, catalog PR=raj. I'll kick the onboard at 09:00 PT and keep this thread open for live notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
